notes: Tool catalog baked into router training (checker-2: do not rely on zero-shot generalization). 13 real tools map 1:1 to live Express routes; 2 pseudo-tools (ask_clarify, refuse) are router-grammar executed by the orchestrator, never the backend. Writes are confirm-gated AND server re-checks JWT role via canCreateStage — the model never authorizes.

tools.name: get_hives
tools.description: List the beekeeper's hives with live health status.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Local weather and climate context for the apiary.

tools.name: verify_jar
tools.description: Verify a honey jar's QR public key against the ledger chain.

tools.name: get_twin
tools.description: Trace a beekeeper's harvest journey (digital twin) by beekeeper id or block hash.

tools.name: predict_yield
tools.description: Formula-based honey yield estimate from sensor trends.

tools.name: search_schemes
tools.description: Search KVIC/PMEGP/NBB scheme and eligibility reference cards.

tools.name: find_centre
tools.description: Find KVIC/Khadi/bee-institute centres near a city.

tools.name: get_my_blocks
tools.description: Personal ledger: caller's own journey (role-scoped server-side).

tools.name: log_extraction
tools.description: WRITE (beekeeper, confirm-gated): log a honey harvest as a honey_extraction block.

tools.name: pool_lot
tools.description: WRITE (KVIC, confirm-gated): merge 2+ farmer harvest hashes into a cooperative lot.

tools.name: issue_sale
tools.description: WRITE (KVIC retail, confirm-gated): register a jar sale and issue verification key.

tools.name: file_rti
tools.description: WRITE (confirm-gated): file a Right-to-Information request about honey journey.

tools.name: ask_clarify
tools.description: PSEUDO: required slots missing — ask the user for them.

tools.name: refuse
tools.description: PSEUDO: request outside role or policy — refuse with explanation.
